verdict.rationale: Khoj documents self-hosting its server on consumer hardware via Docker or Pip, with admin panel, authentication, telemetry opt-out, and offline operation using local models through Ollama, so data never leaves the device. Community users confirm running it locally, though one reported a Docker/pip build failure and another said it slowed an M2 MacBook Air to a crawl. Missing for 10: evidence of reliable, smooth installs (a hands-on build failure was reported) and evidence of acceptable local performance on modest hardware.
